title: Normalized exact open extension on strict constant-coefficient towers
statement: Use the strict constant-coefficient module tower categories and their normalized inverse-image operations [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations]. For an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-open-immersion], the module inverse-image functor is a right adjoint by the localized-site extension-by-zero adjunction [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact]. Its left adjoint $j_!$ is the exact module extension by zero, determined up to the unique unit-preserving adjoint isomorphism. Apply it termwise to strict towers and descend this exact functor to the ordinary unbounded derived categories; write $J_j\dashv G_j$ for the induced adjunction. Its composition and identity isomorphisms are the unit-preserving adjoint isomorphisms conjugate to the normalized inverse-image comparisons [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. Evaluation commutes with $J_j$ by the termwise comparison.

source.place: Tags 0F7B (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open), 0F7C (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-compose), 0F7D (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-compose-horizontal), 0F7F (lemma-shriek-proper-and-open-base-change), open-immersion cases; derived strict-tower and pro-etale refinement of these statements, with the mate construction of sites-cohomology.tex Tag 07A7 (remark-base-change) and proetale.tex Tag 09AE (definition-extension-zero). The source states the etale result; the tower realization, finite-evaluation normalization and pro-etale extension are additional assertions to be proved, not quotations from the source.; strict-tower proof steps introducing these operations.

proof.text: Import the existing generic pro-etale open-extension construction [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]. Specializing its ring sheaves to the constant coefficient sheaves `coefficients B X` and `coefficients B U`, and its comparison isomorphism to `constantRingIso B j`, identifies its module pullback with `modulePullback B j` by unfolding the definitions.

The specialized generic open-restriction theorem `proEtaleOpenRestriction_isRightAdjoint` therefore gives `(modulePullback B j).IsRightAdjoint`, proving `openPullback_isRightAdjoint` and making `moduleJ` its chosen left adjoint.

The specialized exactness theorem `proEtaleRingOpenExtension_exact` gives additivity and finite limit/colimit preservation for the generic left adjoint. The adjunction `moduleJAdj` and the generic adjunction have the same right side, so `Adjunction.leftAdjointUniq` supplies a natural isomorphism from the generic extension to `moduleJ`; transport additivity and finite preservation across this isomorphism.

Apply the resulting module exactness to the existing pointwise whiskering construction. The tower exactness, derived functor, normalized adjunctions, equality transport and evaluation comparison are all definitional or inherited from the strict tower operations, so the remaining declarations compile without additional assumptions.
